data.headline: Southland receives NYSE American listing-standard notice

claims.text: On September 23, 2026, Southland received a NYSE Regulation notice that it was no longer in compliance with NYSE American continued-listing standards.

citation.quote: On September 23, 2026, Southland Holdings, Inc. (the “Company”) received notification (the “Notice”) from NYSE Regulation of the NYSE American LLC (“NYSE American”) that the Company is no longer in compliance with NYSE American’s continued listing standards.

claims.text: The notice cites Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide.

citation.quote: Specifically, the Notice states that the Company is not in compliance with the continued listing standards set forth in Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide (the “Company Guide”).

claims.text: The filing identifies delisting proceedings as a possible next step by NYSE Regulation staff.

citation.quote: plan period, NYSE Regulation staff will initiate delisting proceedings as appropriate.

claims.text: The filing says the notice does not affect Southland’s business operations or SEC reporting obligations.

citation.quote: The receipt of the Notice does not affect the Company’s business operations or its reporting obligations with the SEC.

claims.text: The company reports that its common stock and warrants are publicly traded on NYSE American under symbols SLND and SLND WS.

citation.quote: Our Common Stock, and Warrants are publicly traded on the NYSE American under the symbols “SLND” and “SLND WS”, respectively.
